title: Inside-Out Again
coreMove: Become a transition person by using the pause before response; inherited scripts lose power when one principled choice interrupts them.

exampleSpecs.stakes: one story may pass shame to another generation
a harsh training style may repeat itself
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: choose a response that stops an old script

exampleSpecs.stakes: an argument may become a public family pattern
a child may inherit fear around mistakes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: pass a healthier pattern at the table

exampleSpecs.stakes: a community habit of blame may continue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: move the group from inherited complaint to responsibility

exampleSpecs.stakes: a dishonest shortcut may become team culture
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: stop a pattern before it becomes normal for others
